title: Tickborne Disease Continuing Education | Ticks | CDC
content: Tickborne Disease Continuing Education At a glance These free continuing education activities provide information to healthcare providers on Lyme disease, alpha-gal syndrome, Rocky Mountain spotted fever, ehrlichiosis, anaplasmosis, and viral tickborne disease cases in the United States. Understanding and Managing Alpha-Gal Syndrome for Healthcare Providers This free interactive web-based training is designed to increase knowledge of alpha-gal syndrome among healthcare providers and help more rapidly diagnose patients. Free continuing education is awarded when requested. Understanding and Managing Alpha-Gal Syndrome for Healthcare Providers Ehrlichiosis and Anaplasmosis Continuing Education This free continuing education activity provides information to healthcare providers on the assessment, evaluation, and clinical implications of ehrlichiosis and anaplasmosis cases in the United States. Diagnosis and Treatment of Ehrlichiosis and Anaplasmosis Ehrlichiosis and Anaplasmosis Among Transfusion and Transplant Recipients in the United States Lyme Disease Training Modules This four-part series will enable front-line healthcare providers to recognize, diagnose, and treat Lyme disease, an increasingly common tickborne illness. The free online curriculum serves as a valuable resource for primary care clinicians, public health professionals, pharmacists, and health educators who encounter patients with Lyme disease. Free Continuing Education credits are available. Module 1: Introduction to Tickborne Diseases and Disease Prevention (WB4328R) Module 2: Lyme Disease Clinical Overview (WB4329R) Module 3: Lyme Disease Testing and Diagnosis (WB4330R) Module 4: Lyme Disease Treatment and Management (WB4380R) Improving Care for Patients with Prolonged Symptoms and Concerns about Lyme Disease: A Clinician Toolkit This online toolkit provides educational resources for physicians and other health care professionals to help care for patients with prolonged symptoms and concerns about Lyme disease. The toolkit gathers: Best practices and guidance from CDC, medical professional societies including American Academy of Neurology (AAN), American Academy of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation (AAPMR), American College of Rheumatology (ACR), Infectious Diseases Society of America (IDSA), and practicing clinicians Resources for patients and health care professionals Interviews with experts A CME module Video examples of health care professionals who care for complex patients Tips on how to provide comprehensive and empathetic care Improving Care for Patients with Prolonged Symptoms and Concerns about Lyme Disease: A Clinician Toolkit Clinician Outreach and Communication Activity (COCA) Webinar This webinar provides healthcare providers and their patients with updated information on clinical approaches, tools, and resources for healthcare providers caring for patients with prolonged symptoms and concerns about Lyme disease. Rocky Mountain Spotted Fever Continuing Education These free online trainings and toolkit for healthcare providers and public health practitioners share information on the epidemiology, risk factors, clinical characteristics, treatment, and diagnosis of Rocky Mountain spotted fever (RMSF). These trainings offer free continuing education. Training: RMSF in Southwestern Border States Free online training module designed for clinicians in the Southwest and offers CE credits. Training: Clinical Diagnosis and Treatment Free online training module enhances RMSF knowledge for healthcare providers and offers CE credits. Healthcare Providers Toolkit Resources on epidemiology and treatment of RMSF with instructional videos for providers. Viral Tickborne Disease Continuing Education This free continuing education activity provides information to healthcare providers about tickborne viral diseases endemic to the United States (Powassan, Colorado tick fever, Heartland, and Bourbon viruses). Information on the epidemiology, diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of these diseases is covered during this one-hour interactive course. Viral Tickborne Disease Training (WB4496R) Tick-Borne Encephalitis (TBE) Vaccine Continuing Education This free continuing education activity for healthcare providers describes TBE vaccine recommendations for U.S. travelers and laboratory workers. Healthcare providers can use these guidelines to discuss the risks and benefits of TBE vaccination when they consult with people traveling abroad or with laboratory workers at potential risk for exposure to TBE virus.
